mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_NO, O.USER_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.PAYMENT_STATUS, O.TOTAL_ITEM_AMOUNT, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, O.ORDERED_AT, O.PAID_AT, I.PRODUCT_NAME, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.QUANTITY FROM tb_orders O LEFT JOIN tb_order_items I ON O.ORDER_ID = I.ORDER_ID WHERE O.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY O.REGIST_DT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'CANCEL' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
